description: Generalized model trained across all 3 datasets on 168 proteins, 632k samples
split_strategy: Global protein-aware split — same protein always in same split across datasets

v1_mlp_kmer.architecture: MLP [512,256,128], input=8262 k-mer features (RNA 4-mer + Prot 3-mer + dataset_onehot + extras)
v1_mlp_kmer.failure_mode: Val AUROC peaked at epoch 1, then monotonically degraded. Root cause: RNA length mismatch (RBNS 20nt vs HTR-SELEX 40nt) makes k-mer frequency distributions structurally incompatible across datasets.
v1_mlp_kmer.conclusion: k-mer MLP not viable for cross-dataset training.

v2_cnn_raw_seq.status: DONE — current best (but see known_issue below)
v2_cnn_raw_seq.known_issue: Trained with double class-weighting bug (WeightedRandomSampler + pos_weight simultaneously). Fix applied to scripts/06 on 2026-05-13. Retrain with fixed script before relying on these numbers for publication.
v2_cnn_raw_seq.architecture: Dual-branch CNN: RNA(4-ch, filters [128,256,256], kernels [7,5,3]) + Protein(20-ch, filters [128,256,256], kernels [11,7,5]) → global max pool → concat 512-d → MLP [256,64]
v2_cnn_raw_seq.input: Raw one-hot. RNA padded to 60nt, Protein to 300aa.

worst.note: poorly characterized RBP, no clear motif

v2_cnn_raw_seq.conclusion: Resolves RNA length mismatch vs V1. Protein CNN learns binding motifs end-to-end. Fails on motif-poor / atypical proteins.

v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.known_issue: Trained with double class-weighting bug (WeightedRandomSampler + pos_weight). Fix applied to scripts/08 on 2026-05-13.
v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.architecture: ESM-2 650M frozen mean-pool (1280-d) → Linear(1280→256) + GELU + RNA CNN (256-d) → MLP [256,64]
v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.training_dynamics: Very noisy (val AUPRC oscillates ±0.05 per epoch, never stabilises). Contrast V2 which smoothly peaked at epoch 20.
v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.root_cause: Mean-pooling over all ESM-2 residues dilutes the binding domain signal. Proteins with strong, position-specific motifs (PUM2 Pumilio domain, LARP7 La-motif, TRA2A RRM) lose their discriminative signal in mean-pool. Proteins without clear motifs (UNK, TAF15 — phase-separation, IGF2BP3 — multi-domain) gain from ESM-2 evolutionary context.
v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.key_insight: V2 CNN and frozen ESM-2 encode complementary information: CNN captures local motif patterns, ESM-2 captures protein family context. Simple replacement fails; concatenation is needed.
v3_esm2_frozen_meanpool.conclusion: Frozen mean-pool ESM-2 < one-hot protein CNN. Not a failure of ESM-2 per se — a failure of mean-pooling. Next: V3b concatenates both representations.

v3b_esm2_plus_cnn.known_issue: Trained with double class-weighting bug (WeightedRandomSampler + pos_weight). Fix applied to scripts/09 on 2026-05-13.
v3b_esm2_plus_cnn.architecture: RNA CNN (256-d) + Protein CNN (256-d) + ESM-2 Linear(1280→128) [auxiliary] → concat 640-d → MLP [256,64]
v3b_esm2_plus_cnn.conclusion: Adding ESM-2 mean-pool as auxiliary signal alongside CNN branches still degraded performance. This is the second failed attempt with mean-pool ESM-2 (V3 and V3b). The failure mode is fundamental: mean-pooling is incompatible with motif-rich proteins regardless of architecture. V3c replaces mean-pool with per-residue Conv1D.

v3c_esm2_residue_cnn.status: DONE — WORSE than V2 (but best ESM-2 variant)
v3c_esm2_residue_cnn.architecture: RNA CNN (256-d) + ESM-2 per-residue (L×1280) → Linear(64) per position → Conv1D([128,256], [7,5]) → global max pool (256-d) → concat 512-d → MLP [256,64]
v3c_esm2_residue_cnn.conclusion: ESM-2 residue Conv1D is better than mean-pool (V3b) but does NOT beat one-hot CNN (V2). The positional selectivity gain is insufficient to overcome the signal-to-noise problem with 169 training proteins. Three independent experiments (V3, V3b, V3c) confirm that frozen ESM-2 under any pooling strategy fails to match one-hot CNN on this test set. Next step: cross-attention or fine-tuning, not another frozen pooling variant.
v3c_esm2_residue_cnn.known_issue: Trained with double class-weighting bug (WeightedRandomSampler + pos_weight). Fix applied to scripts/10 on 2026-05-13. Rerun with fixed script for a clean result.

external_validation_v2.dataset: dataset without affinities.xlsx (manually curated, lncRNA + literature)
issues: 88% of proteins are single-class (no per-protein AUROC possible)
Sliding window max-pooling inflates scores for long RNAs: mean prob=0.81 for >60nt vs 0.19 for short
High positive rate (72%): random baseline AUPRC=0.717, real improvement over random is only +0.21
Only 9 of 96 proteins evaluable, average 6 pairs each — near-zero statistical power
external_validation_v2.interpretation: Cannot draw conclusions about generalization to natural lncRNA interactions. Dataset needs expansion to >500 balanced pairs per protein for reliable assessment.
